content_of_post_to_answer: What is your favorite way to stay focused during a long day of data work?
answer: For long data work, I find focus is less about forcing concentration and more about protecting the quality of attention. The hidden drain is not always the workload; it is the constant switching between cleaning data, answering messages, checking results, and making decisions. I try to separate exploration from execution because deep analysis needs a different mental mode. Good data work is not just staying busy longer; it is creating enough uninterrupted space to notice what the numbers are actually saying.
